But the last time he trusted someone, she used his heart to destroy his family, and he's been surviving on guilt and silence ever since. Stiles — armed with too many questions, a Spark he's only beginning to understand, and a terrifyingly mutual attraction to the most emotionally fortified man he's ever met — is going to have to crack Derek open. And then they're going to have to take back the land together.
